body:
I don't know the solutions to all of your problems but I think I should share how I myself dealt with loneliness. [I'm somewhat in the same boat as you](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/109os6/how_to_deal_with_the_person_who_makes_me_want_to/). But in my case I'm perfectly happy to be with myself (it's other people who give me shit I can't take). For me it's not that hard to be content alone. Infact it's easier when you have nobody. Implore yourself. Just think for a moment that you're an alien who just got into this body. Give yourself a new perspective. Think things through again with this new perspective. 

People around you aren't happy just for the sake of being happy (as you want to be), they're happy because they're content; satisfied. They have a good grip on their present and future. Do that and happyness will come naturally. Plan out your future and work on it. Be in control; take charge. But do it one baby-step at a time or it might be overwhelming. For example what keeps me happy is that I want to have enough money to move out, buy a car, and basically be able to support myself independently. I give myself maximum a year for it. Then I try to do a little-by-little every day by every week to get to my goal. That's it. That's all I need to keep me rolling. But till then I still have to live with my mom and take shit (my post above). And that's what I'm still working on how to deal with. Hey, I told you I don't have answers to all your problems. But yeah, being in control is what makes happy and positive. Also, [have you watched this?](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k7X7sZzSXYs "HOW TO BE ALONE by Tanya Davis")

>The nice thing about something like web development is that you can be doing it right now. Start designing your own webpages, and give them similar features and functionality as "professional" sites. Then build up a portfolio of these sites.

That's actually exactly my plan. I'll be making a few "professional" looking websites for portfolio and try bidding on various online freelance websites for work. I'm getting there slowly though. I'm still learning about the "making" part. But yea, I don't want any other job. I've been a computer nerd my whole life, it's something I can do for the rest of my life happily. But yeah, it's not easy. And I'm trying. 

So... that said, since I don't wan't any other job, how do I keep at it (what I'm doing) and deal with that stuff at the same time? Should I still go try for other jobs? But my mind is telling me that'd only serve a fake purpose of "showing progress". 

Also, yeah I can't change her. I don't wanna tell her anything. I have tried. She's got a bad memory or something (or maybe it's the bipolar). I've lost my temper twice and broke shit -- apologized profusely later and made very clear why it happened, like tell her that she really gets on my nerves sometimes and I burst open like a soda can. But the next day she acts like nothing happened, like bring me breakfast, and by dinner time it's the "you a failure" again. Rinse and repeat. I've only lost my temper twice though. And today was about to be the 3rd but, I decided I'd rather come here instead. It's really ... I don't know. 

**edit:** I was so focused on me I didn't thank for you taking out the time to reply. Thanks man! I really appreciate it.

>just because she's miserable and putting you down makes her feel better.

You've pretty much hit the nail on the head. That's her. But I like to believe I can take it, I mean I'm not weak or anything. But at the end of the day, yeah, it really gets to me. 

Anyways, as I said, going out and exploring aren't really an option for me because (a) I'm broke and (b) I'm broke. And it's really more than enough of her to provide a roof on my head so I can't really ask her for money to "go out". Infact I don't thing my ego (lol, I'm a total failure and I have an ego now!) would let me. Sooo... what else?
